selection_policy.purpose: Provide fifteen geographically varied agricultural test sites for evidence collection and deterministic scenario testing.
selection_policy.inheritance_rule: Each representative site inherits crop regional-suitability ratings and planting windows from its parent crop-catalog region; the provider evidence remains coordinate-specific.
selection_policy.location_rule: Prefer the nearest USDA NASS 2024 Cropland Data Layer pixel classified as a named crop, hay, fallow cropland, or agricultural land cover near the selected agricultural center.
selection_policy.limitation: These are representative test points, not farm parcels or region boundaries. CDL is remotely sensed land-cover evidence and does not establish ownership, current management, or field-level ground truth.

sources.name: CropSage crop catalog region vocabulary
sources.use: Defines the five broad parent production regions used by the crop catalog.

sources.name: 2024 Cropland Data Layer
sources.use: Verifies that each representative coordinate falls on a 10-m pixel classified as crop, hay, fallow cropland, or agricultural land cover.

sites.name: Northern Panhandle — Dalhart
sites.justification: Represents the northern High Plains' irrigated and dryland grain environment.

coordinate_verification.method: Nearest qualifying CDL pixel in a systematic search grid around Dalhart.
coordinate_verification.warning: Representative remotely sensed land cover; not a surveyed or farmer-authorized parcel.

sites.name: South Plains — Plainview
sites.justification: Represents the South Plains row-crop and center-pivot production environment and remains close to the existing demo farm.

coordinate_verification.method: Nearest qualifying CDL pixel in a systematic search grid around Plainview.
coordinate_verification.warning: Representative remotely sensed land cover; not a surveyed or farmer-authorized parcel.

sites.name: Rolling Plains — Vernon
sites.justification: Adds the eastern Rolling Plains, where rainfall and production conditions differ from the High Plains.

coordinate_verification.method: Nearest qualifying CDL pixel in a systematic search grid around Vernon.
coordinate_verification.warning: Representative remotely sensed land cover; not a surveyed or farmer-authorized parcel.

sites.name: East Texas — Tyler
sites.justification: Represents humid eastern Texas and its pasture, forage, and smaller diversified farm systems.

coordinate_verification.method: Nearest agricultural land-cover pixel in a systematic search grid; no named row-crop pixel was found in the selected search radius.
coordinate_verification.warning: Pasture is agricultural land cover but does not prove suitability for conversion to any catalog crop.

sites.name: Upper Valley — Mission
sites.justification: Represents the warmer and relatively drier western portion of the Lower Rio Grande Valley.

coordinate_verification.method: USDA CDL 2024 ArcGIS ImageServer point identification near Mission, followed by a complete 22-crop SSURGO contract test and successful FortyGuard TCM coverage probe.
coordinate_verification.warning: The pixel was grassland or pasture in 2024; this confirms agricultural land-cover context, not current cultivation, ownership, or field boundaries.

coordinate_verification.method: Nearest qualifying CDL pixel found in a wider search around Pecos because cropped land is sparse.
coordinate_verification.warning: Representative remotely sensed land cover south of Pecos; not a surveyed or farmer-authorized parcel.

coordinate_verification.method: Nearest qualifying CDL pixel found in a wider search around Fort Stockton because cropped land is sparse.
coordinate_verification.warning: Representative remotely sensed land cover west of Fort Stockton; not a surveyed or farmer-authorized parcel.
